basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old data analyst based in Bengaluru with a keen interest in gaming, particularly action-adventure games like Genshin Impact and Immortals Fenyx Rising. In my downtime, I enjoy exploring the vibrant local food scene and discussing life experiences on subreddits like ToxicFriends. My hours online typically range from late evening to early morning due to my work schedule. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends hiking or attending local gaming meetups.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in business intelligence and data analysis, having completed a degree in computer science. My expertise is largely self-taught through online courses and community discussions. This has also helped me in gaming, where I often analyze game mechanics and strategies.
